SQLite 连接需要数据库文件路径: SQLite connection requires a database file path
只允许单条只读语句: Only a single read-only statement is allowed
引擎必须是 mysql 或 sqlite: Engine must be mysql or sqlite
未找到 mysql 客户端；请安装 MySQL/MariaDB 客户端或配置 m: mysql client not found; install a MySQL/MariaDB client or set mysql_cli
自由 SQL 仅允许 SELECT / SHOW / DESCRIBE / EX: Free SQL allows only SELECT / SHOW / DESCRIBE / EXPLAIN / WITH
请至少指定一个要更新的字段: Specify at least one field to update
